dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Hello, looking to buy some spices?

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: No problem, just let me know when you've made your decision.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: I'm a spice merchant. I mainly provide locals with spices for their daily needs, but I also sell some spiced-up side dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Some researchers even come personally to gather the spices.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: I even got a source for rare Padisarahs through a friend in the Eremites. Come to me if you need some.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: No problem, come back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see someone's pretty well connected.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Hehe, you flatter me... It's just that I often sent gifts to my guests when I first started out, so they were willing to tell others about my store to help my business.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Business is all about treating people with sincerity, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Is this your first time here? Here, take these. I hope they can bring a different flavor to your table.
